title: Shared Rust core
detail: One portable owner for ingestion, token classification, deduplication, sessions and preferences. No Swift, Tauri or platform frameworks in the core.

title: Shared React interface
detail: Overview, sessions, usage, providers, requests, settings and capability map. Shared shadcn/ui, React Bits and Shaders components.

title: MCP service
detail: Original layout/style/app drafts, user Save/Discard, masked native pictures and twelve official SDK tools attach to the running app through its opt-in channel. Packaged relay/client setup and Unix/Windows IPC reuse one Runtime; actual platform/client qualification is reported separately.

title: Claude Code and Codex transcripts
detail: Source-based turn/activity states, incremental JSONL reading, token deduplication, native file-change signals, bounded active-log checks and checkpoints. Claude and Codex sessions with no source events remain unverified; sources that emit no lifecycle events read as idle.

title: Remaining agent provider readers
detail: Original client catalog/discovery plus JSONL, zstd and native SQLite readers are implemented across the principal clients. Original JSONL, SQLite, protobuf, unified/cache formats have targeted fixture coverage; native observer and OS gaps remain in the parity audit. Detection never implies a complete reader, and cross-platform acquisition must be qualified on its host.

title: Account quota and balance
detail: Independent cached original account adapters, coding-plan jobs and adapter-defined credential forms. Secrets stay outside Core/UI. Missing credentials, stale accounts and unpriced usage remain explicit; live endpoint qualification is independent of parsing/fixture checks.

title: Model pricing and estimated costs
detail: Original model-price snapshot, per-kind SQLite facts, quota-cycle metrics and interval Statistics use one selected contribution ledger. Full history/detail paging and usage-bucket projections serve UI and host consumers. Unknown account/model/route/price attribution is not guessed; API period cost/burn/reply/consumption/series uses exact attributable events; mixed model-row visibility remains a gap.

title: Approvals, questions and hooks
detail: Per-client hooks, explicit fixed-executable installation, one request owner, Unix/Windows IPC, withdrawal/timeouts, exact reviewer gating, questions/plans and native receipts. Hook transcript reminders target known logs with three bounded follow-ups. Real-client handoff and Windows runtime qualification are separate.

title: Native HUD and display integration
detail: Three HUD modes, independent screen layouts, edge-only drag, pointer regions, source actors and queued reminders. macOS uses an explicitly created NSPanel retaining Tao methods/ivars; ordinary windows remain unchanged. Live display/IME/focus and Windows/Linux runtime qualification remain required.

title: Signed distribution and updates
detail: Tauri shell and tray are configured. Platform signing, installers, updater feeds and release qualification are not complete.
